subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should the portable message-presentation contract support batch selection, and what array-result and unsupported-channel fallback semantics should plugins rely on?
rationale: This creates a public plugin/message API across channels with unequal native capabilities; source evidence cannot select the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend portable select
options.body: Add explicit batch cardinality and selected-values array semantics to the existing select block with deterministic per-channel fallback.

options.title: Keep native APIs separate
options.body: Leave portable select scalar and document channel-specific Discord and Slack components for advanced collection workflows.

options.title: Defer to dialogs
options.body: Wait for a broader structured-input workflow instead of adding batch semantics to message presentation.

recommendation.title: Extend portable select
recommendation.body: Add explicit batch cardinality and selected-values array semantics to the existing select block with deterministic per-channel fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent merged history for the shared presentation contract and already identified this issue as requiring maintainer follow-up.
